slides.title: What is Ethiopia's transitional justice plan?
Draft laws are ready
slides.body: Justice Minister Hana Arayaselassie said the legal frameworks are drafted and will be published for public review "in the coming days", The Reporter says.

slides.title: Three proposed bodies
slides.body: A Truth and Social Cohesion Commission, an independent Special Prosecutor's Office with a dedicated court bench, and an Institutional Reform Commission.

slides.title: Questions raised
slides.body: Civil society groups asked if they can stay independent on a ministry-chaired platform, and how Tigray will take part. The ministry says it will only facilitate.

slides.title: Inclusive consultations. Credible accountability.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
